documents.content:
# kratos-admin

`kratos-admin` 是一个前后端分离的管理系统仓库，包含 Go + Kratos 后端、Vue 管理后台、uni-app 应用底座、React/Taro 应用底座、版本化数据库迁移和模块脚手架。

## 已实现能力

- 账号密码、验证码、OAuth、TOTP/WebAuthn 多因素认证、JWT 刷新、租户和 Casbin 权限。
- TOTP 多因素认证、一次性恢复码和 `disabled`、`optional`、`all_required` 全局策略。
- 开放授权客户端管理：客户端按租户绑定，凭据换取 Bearer Token，并由 operation 拦截器和 HTTP 加解密 Filter 校验租户、状态、IP 白名单、JSON API 白名单及协议密文。
- 用户、角色、部门、岗位、菜单、字典、配置、任务、文件资产、日志、地区、API 和迁移记录管理。
- 后台工作台提供用户/角色概览、登录趋势、登录结果和操作动作分布统计。
- 消息分类、租户内定向/全员站内信、收件箱已读/归档、Redis 投递恢复和 Admin/uni-app/Taro 消息中心。
- Proto 驱动的 HTTP、gRPC、OpenAPI、Agent Tool、MCP Tool 和 TypeScript RPC 生成。
- AI 会话、流式消息、附件、工具调用、重试、再生成和分支会话。
- 管理端代码生成配置、预览、生成进度和还原。
- 运行日志浏览：实时控制台 SSE、历史日志查询、级别和关键字筛选及历史原文件下载。
- 登录来源策略（全局及租户/用户定向规则）、密码复杂度策略、当前会话撤销、审计日志异步落库与归档、受控 MySQL 备份恢复任务。
- 构建期收集当前项目、宿主项目和外部模块的 README/docs，并在管理端统一查看。
- 可挂载的 Go Core 模块；后端实现 `module.Module`，通过 `Resources` 提供静态资源，并由启动入口交给 Core 统一注册协议服务。
- 管理端、uni-app、Taro 和后端错误目录的语言集合由语言包自动发现；动态菜单、字典和代码生成同步支持所有已注册语言。

仓库不包含商城、订单、支付或推荐等业务模块。

## 目录

| 目录 | 说明 | 文档 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backend` | Kratos 服务、Proto、GORM、迁移和 Core 宿主组合。 | [backend/README.md](backend/README.md) |
| `frontend/admin` | 管理端 workspace，包含默认宿主、core、System 和 CLI。 | [frontend/admin/README.md](frontend/admin/README.md) |
| `frontend/uni-app` | uni-app workspace，包含默认宿主、core、system 和 CLI。 | [frontend/uni-app/README.md](frontend/uni-app/README.md) |
| `frontend/taro-app` | React/Taro workspace，包含默认宿主、core、UI、system 和 CLI。 | [frontend/taro-app/README.md](frontend/taro-app/README.md) |
| `docs` | 当前架构、操作流程和专题说明。 | [docs/README.md](docs/README.md) |

开放授权协议的接口范围、拦截器边界和加密扩展点见 [docs/开放授权协议设计.md](docs/开放授权协议设计.md)。

## 环境

- Go `1.27.0`。
- Node.js `^20.19.0` 或 `>=22.12.0`。
- pnpm 版本以各 workspace 的 `packageManager` 为准：管理端 `10.33.4`，uni-app 与 Taro 应用端 `10.13.1`。
- MySQL 和 Redis；默认连接见 `backend/configs/data.yaml`。
- Docker 部署需要可用的 Docker CLI 与 Docker daemon。
- 启用 TOTP 绑定前需在 `backend/configs/mfa.yaml` 或 `mfa.dev.yaml` 的 `mfa.encryption_key` 中提供 base64 编码的 32 字节密钥；启用 WebAuthn 时还要配置 `mfa.webauthn.rp_id` 与 `mfa.webauthn.rp_origins`。生产环境应使用 KMS/Vault 等密钥管理服务。
- Buf、protoc 插件、Wire 和 gorm-gen 只在重新生成代码时需要，可通过 `make -C backend init` 安装。

直接执行 `make` 或 `make help` 查看仓库级命令；Backend 和 Frontend 的完整目标分别使用 `make -C backend help`、`make -C frontend help` 查看。

## 本地启动

先创建数据库：

```sql
CREATE DATABASE kratos_admin CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
```

安装前端依赖：

```bash
make -C frontend init
```

如果依赖目录需要完全重建：

```bash
make -C frontend reinstall
```

启动后端：

```bash
make -C backend run APP_ENV=dev
```

`run` 会先刷新启动所需的接口、OpenAPI 和 Wire 产物；确认生成产物未变化时可使用 `make -C backend run-only APP_ENV=dev` 直接启动。基础配置使用 `<name>.yaml`，环境差异使用 `<name>.<env>.yaml`，缺少当前环境文件时自动回退基础配置。完整目标、执行顺序和参数见 [Backend 常用流程](backend/README.md#常用流程)。

启动全部前端开发环境（管理后台、uni-app/Taro H5 和微信小程序）：

```bash
make -C frontend run
```

也可以按端启动（每个常驻命令都应在独立终端运行）：

```bash
make -C frontend run-admin
cd frontend/uni-app && pnpm dev:h5
cd ../taro-app && pnpm dev:h5
```

| 服务 | 默认地址 |
| --- | --- |
| 后端 HTTP | `http://localhost:7001` |
| 后端 gRPC | `localhost:6001` |
| 管理后台 | `http://localhost:8848` |
| uni-app H5 | `http://localhost:5004` |
| Taro H5 | `http://localhost:5002` |

uni-app 和 Taro H5 默认分别使用 `5004` 与 `5002`，可以同时启动。局域网设备访问 uni-app 时，将 `localhost` 替换为开发机局域网 IP。

默认迁移提供开发账号 `super / 112233` 和 `admin / 112233`。部署前必须修改默认密码、JWT 密钥、数据库和 Redis 凭据。

## 生成与检查

```bash
make gen
make check
make build
make -C backend fmt
```

`make gen` 按 Backend、Frontend、文档和 OpenAPI 的顺序生成全仓产物；`make check` 按 Backend、三个前端 workspace 和国际化的顺序执行检查。根目录 `make build` 构建后端二进制及三个前端 H5 宿主；只构建全部前端（H5 + 微信小程序）可使用 `make -C frontend build`，仅构建 H5 使用 `make -C frontend build-h5`，生成全部 npm 发布包使用 `make -C frontend package`。

`make -C backend cli` 会安装 `kratos-kit/cmd/normalize-go-imports`，`make -C backend fmt` 再运行该命令并使用 `goimports` 格式化 Backend 全部 Go 文件。

该工具实现统一位于 `kratos-kit/cmd/normalize-go-imports`，不再在 Admin 仓库保留独立 Make 目标。

后端默认通过 `make -C backend build` 构建 `linux/amd64` 二进制；仓库根目录的 `make package` 会生成包含 `bin/server` 和 `configs` 的后端发布压缩包，并同时生成全部前端 npm 包。目标平台可使用 `GOOS`、`GOARCH` 覆盖。

Docker 镜像通过仓库根目录命令构建：

```bash
make docker-build IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=latest
make docker-run IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=latest APP_ENV=dev
make docker-stop IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=latest
```

构建命令先检查 Docker，再构建管理后台、uni-app H5、Taro H5 和 Linux 后端程序。运行命令发布宿主机 `7001/6001` 端口，将 `backend/data` 映射到 `/app/data`，并首次初始化可在宿主机修改的 `backend/runtime/configs` 后映射到 `/app/configs`。三端静态站点随镜像发布，启动时合并到 `/app/data`，已有上传文件不会被清空。完整构建参数和运行示例见本节。

本地只启动依赖服务可使用：

```bash
docker compose -f docker-compose.libs.yml up -d
docker compose -f docker-compose.libs.yml --profile object-storage up -d
```

该 Compose 只负责 MySQL、Redis 和可选 MinIO，不改变现有单镜像应用部署方式。

`I18N_LOCALES` 使用逗号分隔的 BCP 47 语言代码列表（默认 `en-US,zh-TW,ja-JP`），统一控制项目文档和 OpenAPI 的目标语言。`make i18n-docs` 由仓库内 `scripts/project_docs.py` 按三段路径范围收集 README 与 docs Markdown，再将正文按 `I18N_BATCH_CHARS`（默认 400）分片翻译并按原顺序合并，生成 `docs.json` 和 `docs.<locale>.json`；对应的 `README.en-US.md`、`guide.ja-JP.md` 等语言源文件存在时直接使用，否则才执行机器翻译。Google V1 会按多个 client 顺序切换，全部不可用时再使用 MyMemory，并保留 Markdown 代码、链接和占位符。语言目录只本地化文档正文和显示文件名，`README.md` 显示名、目录名称及稳定路径保持不变。如需使用外部实现，可通过 `PROJECT_DOCS_SCRIPT` 覆盖脚本路径。`make i18n-openapi` 生成 OpenAPI 多语言 YAML。离线生成使用 `I18N_OFFLINE=1 make i18n`。

`backend/api/gen`、`backend/internal/data/gen`、`backend/internal/docs/assets/docs*.json`、`backend/internal/docs/docs.go`、各前端包的 `src/rpc`、OpenAPI 及 `wire_gen.go` 都是生成产物，不得手工修改。所有前端 RPC 的 Buf 配置统一位于 `backend/api`，管理端通过 `make -C frontend ts-admin` 生成，应用端分别通过 `make -C frontend ts-uni-app` 和 `make -C frontend ts-taro-app` 生成；需要一次生成三端时执行 `make -C frontend ts`，全仓生成使用根目录 `make gen`。

`make -C backend gen` 会同时生成 `backend/internal/module` 的公共入口内部 Wire 产物和 `backend/internal/cmd/server` 的独立启动 Wire 产物；单独刷新前者使用 `make -C backend public-wire`，单独刷新自定义组合根可通过 `WIRE_DIR` 指定包含 `wire.go` 的目录。

外部 Go 项目将 `github.com/liujitcn/kratos-admin/backend` 的具名模块、资源、定时任务、SSE 流和队列消费者贡献与自身贡献合并后，再交给 `github.com/liujitcn/kratos-core` 创建协议服务及应用生命周期；外部生成代码不会引用 `backend/internal`。

`make i18n-openapi` 会在生成 `openapi.yaml` 后同步生成 `openapi.en-US.yaml`、`openapi.zh-TW.yaml` 和 `openapi.ja-JP.yaml`。默认资源来自后端错误目录和管理端 Core 语言包；外部资源可通过 `OPENAPI_I18N_CONTENT="locale=path"` 传入。未命中的文案默认自动翻译：英文和日语使用 Google V1，繁体中文使用 OpenCC；设置 `I18N_AUTO_LOCALIZE=0` 可关闭自动翻译。无网络环境使用 `I18N_OFFLINE=1 make i18n-openapi`。

## 国际化

语言包定义系统能够渲染的语言集合，`base_language` 表只负责运行时启用状态、名称、排序和主语言配置。管理端语言偏好保存为 `kratos-admin:locale`，uni-app 和 Taro 保存为 `kratos-app:locale`；所有 HTTP、刷新令牌、fetch、SSE、uni.request 和 Taro.request 请求都会发送规范化的 `Accept-Language`。固定文案由各 workspace 的 core/System JSON 语言包维护，动态菜单和字典由后端翻译表按请求语言解析，缺少当前语言译文时回退主语言。

新增语言不需要修改 Go、TypeScript 或模块注册代码：在 `backend/internal/i18n/assets` 和三个 workspace 的六个前端语言包目录中增加同名 JSON，然后执行 `make i18n-sync`。脚本会校验语言集合、语言键和占位符，并生成六个前端注册文件、Element Plus 和 Day.js 映射。语言名称、排序、启用状态和主语言由 `base_language` 数据库记录提供；`common.language.*` 用于编译期离线显示和生成语言迁移的初始名称。新增语言的完整文件清单和迁移流程见 [国际化语言扩展指南](docs/国际化语言扩展指南.md)。需要把语言加入新部署数据库时，再执行 `make i18n-sync I18N_MIGRATION_VERSION=vX.Y.Z`，提交脚本生成的版本化 `base_language` 迁移；已有数据库的启用状态不会被迁移覆盖。

动态资源的主语言由 `base_language.is_primary` 配置。创建或更新菜单、字典、字典项和系统配置时，后端按请求 `Accept-Language` 将输入文本转换为主语言写入主表；请求语言不是主语言时，原文写入对应翻译表，其他已启用非主语言也只保存在翻译表。系统配置名称、菜单标题、字典名称和字典项标签支持在管理端点击名称打开翻译弹窗，文本/富文本配置值支持运行时翻译回退。

国际化常用命令：

```bash
make i18n-check
make i18n-verify
make i18n-sync
make i18n-docs
make i18n-openapi
make i18n
```

新增语言按目标版本写入版本化迁移；当前项目全部属于初始化数据，统一写入 `v0.0.1`：

```bash
I18N_LOCALE=ja-JP make i18n-locale
I18N_LOCALE=de-DE I18N_OFFLINE=1 make i18n-locale
```

在线模式优先使用 Google V1 的多个 client，全部不可用时使用 MyMemory；繁体中文优先使用 OpenCC，离线模式使用内置术语表和 OpenCC。生成后应审核 JSON 与 SQL；已有数据库的语言启用状态不会被覆盖。运行时翻译表单仍可对动态资源执行即时翻译，已有非空译文不会覆盖。

## 发布

统一发布会更新并发布 10 个 npm 包：

- `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-system`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-cli`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app-core`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app-system`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app-cli`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-core`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-ui`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-system`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-cli`

```bash
make tag VERSION=0.0.30
```

`make tag` 会先执行只读的 `make i18n-verify`，检查语言包、SQL 翻译脚本、OpenAPI 多语言文档和项目文档生成物；生成物未同步时会直接拒绝发布，不会在发布过程中自动翻译或改写文件。随后发布脚本要求当前分支为远程默认分支且与 `origin` 同步，执行后端测试和前端打包，然后推送 `vX.Y.Z`、`backend/vX.Y.Z`、`npm/vX.Y.Z`。`npm/vX.Y.Z` 触发 `.github/workflows/publish-npm.yml`，通过 npm Trusted Publishing 发布以上 10 个包；三个默认宿主均为私有包，不参与发布。本机需要可用的 `git`、`gh` 和 GitHub 登录态。

只做本地 npm 发布时：

```bash
pnpm login
make -C frontend publish
```

发布脚本会跳过 registry 中已存在的同版本包，支持失败后重试。私有 registry 可通过 `NPM_REGISTRY`、`NPM_ACCESS` 和 `NPM_TAG` 覆盖。

documents.content:
# backend

Backend 同时提供消息分类、站内信管理、用户收件箱、Redis 投递恢复、后台工作台统计、文件资产元数据、登录来源策略、会话撤销、审计事件异步落库、日志归档和受控数据库备份任务。安全、消息和开放授权默认数据统一由 `v0.0.1` 初始化迁移提供。

`backend` 保留 API 契约、Go 生成接口、Service 实现、Biz 业务层，以及任务调度、HTTP/gRPC/MCP/AI 注册和必要的数据访问闭包；进程入口位于 `internal/cmd/server`。根包通过 `ProviderSet`、`NewModuleResources`、`NewModules`、`NewTasks`、`NewStreams` 和 `NewQueueConsumers` 提供可被外部 Core 宿主复用的公共边界，`internal/module` 仅承载内部实现。AI Runtime 实现在 `internal/biz`，对外复用入口为 `pkg/agent`；业务模块通过 `pkg/notification.Publish` 发布站内信，由内部事务和 Dispatch 恢复链路负责最终投递。开放授权客户端使用单表 JSON operation 白名单并绑定租户，公开端点签发客户端 Bearer Token；HTTP middleware 分别校验租户、状态、IP 白名单和 API 范围，HTTP 加解密 Filter 在请求绑定前解密客户端数据并在成功响应后加密。登录认证支持 TOTP 多因素认证、一次性恢复码，以及全局和租户/用户定向登录来源策略。

## 目录

```text
backend
├── internal/cmd/server             # Admin 独立启动入口与 Wire 组合根
├── api
│   ├── proto                         # Proto 契约
│   └── gen/go                        # Buf 生成的 Go 接口、HTTP、gRPC 和工具代码
├── internal/biz                      # 业务 Case、DTO、代码生成和辅助领域代码
├── bootstrap.go                      # 对外 ProviderSet 和模块/任务/SSE/队列/资源入口
├── internal/module                   # Admin 到 kratos-core 的内部模块适配和资源实现
│   ├── module.go                     # Core Module 协议注册
│   ├── resources.go                  # module.Module 静态资源
│   ├── init.go                        # Admin 模块 ProviderSet
│   └── wire.go / wire_gen.go          # 公共入口使用的内部依赖装配
├── pkg/agent                         # 对外复用的 AI Runtime、模型和工具 API
├── pkg/notification                  # 对外复用的站内信发布 API
├── internal/task                     # 异步任务与定时任务执行器
├── internal/server                   # 服务拦截器和 API 模块注册适配
│   └── middleware/{oauth,logstream}  # 按业务分组的 HTTP/gRPC 服务拦截器
├── internal/data/gen                 # GORM 生成的模型、查询和仓储
├── internal/service                  # Proto Service 实现
├── internal/const                    # 业务常量
├── internal/i18n/assets              # 业务语言资源
└── migration                         # 代码生成业务使用的迁移资源
```

## 常用流程

进入 `backend` 目录后，先通过帮助查看全部目标、参数默认值和覆盖示例：

```bash
make help
```

首次开发安装 Buf、protoc、Wire、gorm-gen、goimports 和检查工具：

```bash
make init
```

日常启动使用：

```bash
make run
```

`make run` 会按“protobuf Go -> OpenAPI -> 独立入口 Wire -> 启动服务”的顺序刷新必要产物。确认生成产物没有变化时，可跳过生成直接启动：

```bash
make run-only
```

默认配置目录为 `./configs`，默认运行环境为 `dev`。基础配置使用 `<name>.yaml`，环境差异使用 `<name>.<env>.yaml`；环境文件存在时在基础配置之后加载，不存在时回退基础配置。可以覆盖配置目录、运行环境或追加启动参数：

多因素认证方式由系统配置 `securityMfaMethod` 选择，当前支持 `totp` 和 `webauthn`。运行时 MFA 参数通过 `mfa.yaml` 或环境覆盖文件 `mfa.dev.yaml` 的 `mfa` 节点加载；启用 TOTP 绑定前，需要配置 `mfa.encryption_key`（base64 编码的 32 字节密钥）。管理端和应用端禁用 TOTP 需要当前密码和动态口令或恢复码，禁用 WebAuthn 需要当前密码和一次 Passkey 或恢复码验证。生产环境应从 KMS、Vault 或 Secret Manager 注入配置文件或其挂载内容，不要把真实密钥写入仓库或数据库。完整字段以 `kratos-kit/api/proto/config/v1/mfa.proto` 为准。

```bash
make run-only CONF=/path/to/configs
make run-only APP_ENV=prod
make run-only RUN_ARGS='--help'
```

例如 `APP_ENV=dev` 会加载 `data.yaml` 后再加载 `data.dev.yaml`，同时忽略 `data.prod.yaml`。本地开发配置统一保存在 `*.dev.yaml`，这类文件默认不纳入 Git。

独立入口注入 `kratoscore.ProviderSet` 与内部模块 ProviderSet；Core 负责统一创建和管理 HTTP、gRPC、MCP、SSE、队列与定时任务运行时。Admin 注册六张完整审计日志模型并负责自动迁移；Core 异步写入 API/策略日志，Admin 异步写入登录、操作、数据访问和权限日志。

## 修改后执行

| 修改场景 | 命令 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Proto 契约 | `make api openapi` | 生成 Backend protobuf Go 和 OpenAPI 源文档；前端 TypeScript RPC 使用仓库根目录的 `make -C ../frontend ts`，也可按端执行 `ts-admin`、`ts-uni-app` 或 `ts-taro-app`。 |
| 数据库表结构 | `make gorm-gen` | 先更新开发库，再按 `GORM_GEN_CONFIG`、`GORM_GEN_DATABASE` 和 `GORM_TABLE` 生成。 |
| ProviderSet 或构造参数 | `make public-wire wire` | 分别刷新公共入口内部装配和独立服务入口。 |
| README 或 docs | `make -C .. project-docs` | 从仓库根目录收集 Markdown，并生成各语言文档目录。 |
| 语言包或国际化资源 | `make -C .. i18n` | 国际化属于仓库根目录公共命令。 |
| Go import 别名 | `make cli fmt` | `cli` 安装 `kratos-kit/cmd/normalize-go-imports`，`fmt` 运行它并使用 `goimports` 格式化。 |
| 多类后端生成源同时变化 | `make gen` | 依次执行 GORM、接口、OpenAPI、Wire 和格式化；需要可访问开发数据库。 |

所有生成产物都必须通过上述命令刷新，不能手工修改。

Go import 别名规范化命令由 `kratos-kit/cmd/normalize-go-imports` 提供，Admin 不保留本地副本；先安装命令，再执行格式化：

```bash
make cli
make fmt
```


## 检查

提交前执行完整 Backend 检查：

```bash
make check
```

`make check` 依次运行 `make lint` 和 `make test`，不会自动格式化代码。全仓检查（含国际化）请在仓库根目录执行 `make check`。需要格式化时先执行：

```bash
make fmt
```

也可以单独运行某一项：

```bash
make lint
make test
```

## 构建

默认构建 `linux/amd64`、`CGO_ENABLED=0` 的可执行文件：

```bash
make build
```

产物为 `bin/server`。其他平台可以覆盖参数：

```bash
make build GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 BINARY=bin/server-darwin-arm64
```

发布压缩包、Docker 镜像和三端静态资源属于仓库级流程，请在根目录执行 `make package` 或 `make docker-build`；对应参数和运行示例见根目录 README。

## 常用参数

| 参数 | 默认值 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONF` | `./configs` | 服务运行配置目录。 |
| `APP_ENV` | `dev` | 选择 `<name>.<env>.yaml` 环境覆盖配置。 |
| `RUN_ARGS` | 空 | 追加到服务命令后的参数。 |
| `CGO_ENABLED` | `0` | Go 构建时是否启用 CGO。 |
| `GOOS` / `GOARCH` | `linux` / `amd64` | 构建目标平台。 |
| `BINARY` | `bin/server` | 可执行文件输出路径。 |
| `ARCHIVE` | `dist/backend-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz` | 后端二进制压缩包输出路径（由根目录 `make package` 调用）。 |
| `PUBLIC_WIRE_DIR` | `internal/module` | 公共入口使用的内部 `wire.go` 所在目录。 |
| `WIRE_DIR` | `internal/cmd/server` | 独立入口 `wire.go` 所在目录。 |
| `GORM_GEN_CONFIG` | `configs/data.dev.yaml` | GORM 生成使用的数据源配置。 |
| `GORM_GEN_DATABASE` | 空 | 可选数据库名，默认读取配置文件。 |
| `GORM_TABLE` | 内置表清单 | 逗号分隔的 GORM 生成表。 |

## 外部宿主复用

外部 Go 项目复用 Backend 时，在自己的 Wire 组合根中加入 `kratoscore.ProviderSet`、`backend.ProviderSet` 和宿主的合并 ProviderSet：

```go
func NewApp(ctx *bootstrap.Context) (*kratos.App, func(), error) {
	panic(wire.Build(
		kratoscore.ProviderSet,
		backend.ProviderSet,
		mergeProviderSet,
	))
}
```

根包通过 `AdminResources`、`AdminModules`、`AdminTasks`、`AdminStreams` 和 `AdminConsumers` 输出具名贡献，宿主的合并 ProviderSet 将它们与其他业务模块的贡献显式追加为 Core 最终集合。公开构造器只使用 Core 公共类型，外部生成的 `wire_gen.go` 不会依赖 `backend/internal`。

`backend.NewModules` 初始化的是宿主进程级运行日志采集器；外部项目按上述方式接入 Backend 后，其自身以及其他已注册模块写入 stdout/stderr 的日志也会进入运行日志实时控制台，历史日志文件则按宿主的日志配置读取。

`configs/auth.yaml` 中的 JWT 密钥仅用于本地开发示例；生产环境必须通过对应的 `auth.<env>.yaml` 覆盖为密钥管理服务提供的随机密钥。

外部模块接入 AI 时使用 `pkg/agent.NewRuntime` 创建运行时，通过 `RuntimeConfig.AdminTools/AppTools` 或 `Runtime.RegisterTool` 注册 Eino `InvokableTool`；简单结构化工具优先使用 `pkg/agent.InferTool` 自动生成参数 schema。评论审核、内容提取等固定流程可以组合 `NewChatClient`、`NewStructuredRunner`、`SchemaFor` 和多模态 Part 构造函数，不需要引用 `internal` 包。需要权限控制时实现 `ToolAccessChecker`，不接入权限系统则保持 `Checker` 为 `nil`。

documents.name: AI Assistant Design.md
documents.content:
# AI ASSISTANT

AI assistant is a conversational capability shared by the management side, uni-app and Taro application side. The three portals use the same set of `base.v1` interfaces and data tables, but filter the available tools and shortcut portals by terminal.

## Implemented capabilities

- Session creation, listing, renaming, deleting and persisting branches.
- Message list, text and attachment sending, editing last message, deletion, failed retry and regeneration.
- Direct streaming response to three types of SSE events: `delta`, `finish`, `error`.
- Markdown, model source, token, first token time consumption, total time consumption and tool call record.
- Filter generated Agent Tools by terminal, interface switch and user permissions.
- Fixed process quick entry and structured actions; old message actions will be judged as expired by the server.
- Responses server tool record; returns an explicit unavailable error when the current model is not enabled.

## Contracts and Data

| Capabilities | Proto | HTTP Prefix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Quick entry | `backend/api/proto/base/v1/ai_tool.proto` | `/api/v1/base/ai/shortcut` |
| Session | `ai_session.proto` | `/api/v1/base/ai/session` |
| Messages | `ai_message.proto` | `/api/v1/base/ai/session/{session_id}/message` |

Data persisted to `ai_session` and `ai_message`. A round of messages saves input, output, attachments, tools, tokens, time consumption, status and optional structured process content. The action must carry `source_message_id`, `action_id` and `flow_version` of the current latest success message.

The HTTP handler sending the message returns `text/event-stream` directly, without using the generic `/events/{stream}` subscription. The `finish` event at the end of the flow returns the final message and updated session.

## Backend link

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  API["AiMessageService"] --> Case["AiMessageCase"]
  Case --> Runtime["biz/base/ai.Runtime"]
  Runtime --> ADK["internal/biz/agent/adk"]
  ADK --> Model["Eino Agentic Model"]
  ADK --> Tools["按终端和权限筛选的工具"]
  Case --> DB[("ai_session / ai_message")]
```

`internal/biz/base/ai` is responsible for business protocols, historical messages, attachments, terminal policies, fixed processes and result persistence; `internal/biz/agent` isolates Eino's model, messages, ADK, Middleware, Callback, Tool, Structured and Workflow details.

Agent Tool comes from generated code, `agent_status` controls whether it can be used by AI; `mcp_status` independently controls whether it is exposed as MCP Tool. The two are not the same switch.

## Management end

The management terminal is located at `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/views/ai/chat`:

| Documentation | Responsibilities |
| --- | --- |
| `index.vue` | Total orchestration of conversations, messages, sends and actions. |
| `components/SessionPanel.vue` | Session search, creation, switching, renaming and deletion. |
| `components/ChatPanel.vue` | Message area, empty state, shortcut entry and message operation. |
| `components/XSender.vue` | Text, attachments and delivery status. |
| `components/AiMarkdown.vue` | Markdown and code content. |
| `stream.ts`, `message.ts` | SSE parsing and message status normalization. |

The System module also registers the AI ​​icon as a top tool. The Structured Process Block component is not a built-in fixed implementation; other business modules can provide `flowBlocks` extensions via `ADMIN_AI_EXTENSION`.

## Application side

uni-app is located at `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai` and Taro is located at `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai`. Both ends provide session drawers, welcome shortcuts, input and attachments, message flows, and multi-end SSE parsing. The pages belong to the `pagesMember` subpackage and use the same `base.v1` RPC and API encapsulation. H5 uses Fetch SSE; WeChat applets use the chunked request capabilities of their respective platforms.

## Configuration and verification

The basic configuration of the model is located at `backend/configs/ai.yaml`, and the development environment difference is located at `backend/configs/ai.dev.yaml`. The service can still be started when the full model configuration is not provided, but the AI ​​runtime is turned off.

Execute backend generation and testing after modifying the protocol or runtime; modify the management side to execute `pnpm lint:oxlint`, `pnpm type:check`; modify uni-app or Taro to execute `pnpm lint`, `pnpm tsc` corresponding to the workspace, and then execute when the module protocol or runner is involved. `pnpm test`, `pnpm check:exports`. The front-end checks at least empty session, historical session, sending, failed, attachment and expired process action status.

documents.content:
# Front-end component list

This article only records the components and their boundaries that exist in the current code and can be used directly. The management component implementation is located in `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/components`; the base components, UI packages and page private components of uni-app and Taro belong to their respective workspaces.

## Management-side public components

| Scenario | Component | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Paged lists, searches, column settings, bulk operations | `ProTable` | Configure lists using `columns`, `headerActions`, and `requestApi`. |
| Add or edit pop-up window | `FormDialog` | Combining `ProDialog` and `ProForm`, the page is responsible for verification, submission and refresh. |
| Details, preview, or non-form popup | `ProDialog` | Content organized by default or named slots. |
| Configuration form | `ProForm` | Fields are described by `ProFormField[]` and support existing controls such as input, selection, dictionary, upload, and rich text. |
| Dictionary selection and display | `Dict`, `DictLabel` | Registered as a global component by the core startup process. |
| Image upload | `UploadImg` | Core's public upload component; multi-image and file upload are currently only for core internal use. |
| Tree filter | `TreeFilter` | Support static data or request loading, single selection and multi-selection. |
| Icon selection | `SelectIcon` | Select the Element Plus icon name. |
| Markdown read-only preview | `MarkdownPreview` | Encapsulation `md-editor-v3`, unified security cleaning, code highlighting, light and dark themes and compact code block style. |
| Rich text | `WangEditor` | Encapsulate wangEditor and reuse the file upload service. |
| Password strength | `PasswordStrength` | Login, user and personal center password form usage. |

`CronExpression`, `ECharts`, `Grid`, `ImportExcel`, `SelectFilter`, `SwitchDark` and other components do exist but have not been passed through npm `exports` is open and should only be used within core. Whether it can be referenced across packages is subject to `frontend/admin/packages/core/package.json#exports`, and the source code directory cannot be regarded as a public interface.

## Public import entry

The business module uses the core package to expose the entry and does not reference `packages/core/src`:

```ts
import ProTable from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProTable";
import FormDialog from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Dialog/FormDialog.vue";
import MarkdownPreview from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/MarkdownPreview/index.vue";
import type {
  ColumnProps,
  HeaderActionProps,
  ProTableInstance
} from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProTable/interface";
import type {
  ProFormField,
  ProFormInstance
} from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProForm/interface";
```

The currently exposed Vue component entries are as follows:

| Components | npm entry |
| --- | --- |
| `FormDialog` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Dialog/FormDialog.vue` |
| `ProDialog` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Dialog/ProDialog.vue` |
| `DictLabel` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Dict/DictLabel.vue` |
| `MarkdownPreview` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/MarkdownPreview/index.vue` |
| `PasswordStrength` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/PasswordStrength/index.vue` |
| `ProForm` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProForm/index.vue` |
| `ProTable` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProTable` |
| `SelectIcon` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/SelectIcon/index.vue` |
| `TreeFilter` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/TreeFilter/index.vue` |
| `UploadImg` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Upload/Img.vue` |
| `WangEditor` | `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/WangEditor/index.vue` |

`bootstrapAdminApp` also globally registers the Element Plus icon as well as `Dict`, `DictLabel`, `SvgIcon`. Global registration facilitates direct use of templates and does not mean that the corresponding source code path has become a public entrance to npm.

## Lists and forms

### ProTable

`ProTable` is defined in `packages/core/src/components/ProTable/interface/index.ts`. Common configurations include:

- `columns`: columns, search terms, dictionaries, status and row operations.
- `requestApi`: paging request, return `{ data: { list, total } }`.
- `headerActions`: Header operations such as new addition and batch deletion.
- `cellType`: Existing `image`, `status`, `actions`, `money` cells.
- `dictCode`: Use system dictionary display or search.

page request uses core's table tool to convert paging parameters:

```ts
import { buildPageRequest } from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/table";

async function requestTable(params: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const response = await service.PageResource(buildPageRequest(params));
  return {
    data: {
      list: response.resources ?? [],
      total: response.total
    }
  };
}
```

table instance provides the ability to re-request, search, reset, clear selection, and read the current selection and paging status. The specific type is subject to `ProTableInstance`.

### ProForm and FormDialog

`ProFormField` currently supports input boxes, numbers, segmented selections, check boxes, switches, drop-downs, radio selections, multi-selections, dictionaries, tree selections, dates, Cron, shuttle boxes, image and file uploads, rich text, dynamic lists, key-value lists and custom slots.

A typical pop-up window only needs to expose components and field types:

```vue
<FormDialog
  ref="dialogRef"
  v-model="dialogVisible"
  :model="formModel"
  :fields="formFields"
  :rules="rules"
  @confirm="handleSubmit"
  @closed="resetForm"
/>
```

`FormDialog` is only responsible for interaction and verification entry, and does not automatically call the business interface. The page executes `validate()` in the confirmation event, submits the service, closes the pop-up window and refreshes the form. After closing, the model and verification status are explicitly reset.

## Markdown Preview

`MarkdownPreview` is used for read-only content such as project documentation, database migration instructions, and AI replies. The component uniformly injects local Highlight.js in the core, uses DOMPurify to clean rendering results, generates anchor points compatible with Chinese and repeated titles, and turns off Mermaid, KaTeX, ECharts, image enlargement, code folding and code line numbers.

```vue
<MarkdownPreview
  :model-value="content"
  :is-dark="globalStore.isDark"
  max-code-height="360px"
/>
```

`modelValue` is the original Markdown text, `isDark` follows the host theme, and `maxCodeHeight` only limits the maximum height of long code blocks. Single-line and double-line code blocks are always rendered at the actual content height. Business modules must no longer rely directly on the underlying `md-editor-v3` or maintain another set of Markdown themes.

## Internal components

The following components are existing implementations but are not listed in the public npm entry:

| Table of Contents | Capabilities |
| --- | --- |
| `components/Card` | Data overview card. |
| `components/CronExpression` | Six-section Cron editor. |
| `components/ECharts` | Bar, Line, Pie and other chart containers. |
| `components/ErrorMessage` | 403, 404, 500 and other error status display. |
| `components/Grid`, `SearchForm` | Responsive layout for the ProTable search area. |
| `components/ImportExcel` | Excel file import pop-up window. |
| `components/Loading` | Page and full screen loading status. |
| `components/SelectFilter` | Multiple sets of filter conditions. |
| `components/SwitchDark` | Switch between light and dark themes. |
| `components/Upload` | Upload single image, multiple images, single file, and multiple files. |

When the business module requires one of the capabilities, first confirm whether there is a public entrance. If there is indeed a need for cross-module reuse, add a clear single-component entry in `package.json#exports` of the core, and synchronize construction and type checking; do not add `components/*` wildcard export.

## Layout and page components

Four management-side layouts are located in `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/layouts`: `LayoutVertical`, `LayoutClassic`, `LayoutTransverse`, `LayoutColumns`. They are selected by core routing and global settings and are not used as business page components.

The page private components of the System module are located in `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/views/**/components`, such as the user page department tree, personal center form and code generation preview components. `src/components/Ai.vue` is the AI ​​entry System registered to the top toolbar. None of these components currently have npm public exports.

## Application component

uni-app core provides two base components `BootstrapStatus` and `KratosTabBar`. The public entrance is subject to `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app-core/components/*.vue`; Taro core provides the corresponding `BootstrapStatus`, `KratosPageFrame` and `KratosTabBar`, and exposed through `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-core/components/*`. Taro's `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-ui` is also responsible for NutUI theme and icon entry, but does not host business pages.

The following components are private components of the AI ​​page in the two application-side system modules:

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components/Composer.vue` | uni-app message input, attachment and send operations. |
| `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components/SessionDrawer.vue` | uni-app session list and switching. |
| `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components/WelcomePanel.vue` | uni-app AI page welcome area and quick entry. |
| `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components/Composer.tsx` | Taro message entry, attachment and send operations. |
| `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components/SessionDrawer.tsx` | Taro session list and switching. |
| `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components/WelcomePanel.tsx` | Taro AI page welcome area and quick entry. |

They only serve their respective `pagesMember/ai` pages and are not part of the public component interface of the application base. After at least two pages are truly reused without business semantics, consider upgrading them to the public component directory of the corresponding workspace.

## Maintenance basis

- Management side public export: `frontend/admin/packages/core/package.json#exports`
- Management component source code: `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/components`
- System page and private components: `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src`
- uni-app base component: `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/components`
- Taro base assembly: `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/components`
- Taro UI theme and icon: `frontend/taro-app/packages/ui/src`
- Application page private component: `packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai/components` of two workspaces

Component properties and instance methods are subject to the Vue/TypeScript type definitions in the same directory; this article does not copy the complete props to avoid retaining the invalidity of the document after adjustment.

# International Design

This article describes the internationalization boundaries, runtime behavior, and data responsibilities currently implemented by the warehouse. The specific operation of adding a new language is subject to the [International Language Expansion Guide](国际化语言扩展指南.md).

## Current conclusion

| Content | Current Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Fixed language pack | `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `en-US`, `ja-JP` |
| Compile-time default language | `zh-CN` |
| Dynamic resource master language | Determined by `base_language.is_primary` |
| Fixed copywriting | core/System JSON language pack for three front-end workspaces |
| Backend Error | Structured JSON directory for `backend/internal/i18n/assets` |
| Runtime language options | Enabled languages returned by `base_language` interface |
| Dynamic Resources | Menus, dictionaries, dictionary entries, and system configuration name/value translation tables |
| Machine Translation | Empty translations can be generated and saved on demand; existing non-empty translations will not be overwritten |

Internationalization is not about putting all language names or translation constants into the database. The database is responsible for deployment and configuration, and the language package is responsible for the whitelist and fixed copy during compilation; new languages ​​must update both layers at the same time.

## Runtime link

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Files["语言包 JSON"] --> Sync["scripts/sync_locales.py"]
  Sync --> UI["固定 UI 与错误目录"]
  DB["base_language"] --> Options["运行时语言选项"]
  Request["Accept-Language"] --> Locale["locale 规范化"]
  Locale --> UI
  Locale --> Dynamic["动态菜单/字典/配置解析"]
  Dynamic --> Tables[("翻译表")]
```

### Compile-time language collection

`scripts/sync_locales.py` scans the following seven language pack directories; the code generator copy is also stored in the back-end language directory and passes the `system.code.gen.*` prefix verification:

```text
backend/internal/i18n/assets
frontend/admin/packages/core/src/locales
frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/locales
frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/locales
frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales
frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/locales
frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales
```

The file set, fixed keys and placeholders of the seven language pack directories must be consistent; the `system.code.gen.*` key in the back-end language file is directly reused by the code generator. The script generates six front-end `generated.ts` and verifies the locale mapping of Day.js and Element Plus on the management side. Core's `resource/i18n` receives host language resources. Core is responsible for directory loading and error localization internally, and does not embed project entries. The generated files cannot be modified manually.

### Runtime language configuration

`base_language` Save:

- `language_code`: canonical BCP 47 language code;
- `language_name`, `native_name`: management terminal and login page display name;
- `status`, `sort`: whether optional and display order;
- `is_primary`: Primary language for dynamic menus, dictionaries and system configuration.

When the front end is started, it first uses the compile-time package to establish a fallback language list, and then requests the public language interface; when the database interface succeeds, it is based on the enabled language and sorting, and when it fails, it falls back to the compile-time language list. The deployment configuration should only enable languages ​​that have been published with the package, the database records themselves will not generate missing language packages.

### Requests and rollbacks

Management-side Axios, refresh token, fetch, SSE and Swagger requests, as well as uni-app/Taro requests, uploads and SSE, uniformly send standardized `Accept-Language`. The backend matches the area according to the whitelist, and the unknown value falls back to `zh-CN`.

The rollback sequence is as follows:

```text
固定 UI：当前语言 -> zh-CN -> 安全默认文案
菜单/字典/配置：当前语言非空翻译 -> 主表主语言字段 -> 稳定 code/path
错误：当前语言 message_key -> zh-CN message_key -> 原始安全消息 -> INTERNAL_ERROR
```

Raw keys, unsaved machine translation results, database errors, SQL or third-party provider responses are not displayed at runtime.

## Fixed copy and error directory

Each front-end module maintains its own JSON language package. The language set, key, namespace and placeholder are verified when the module is registered. Core maintains general capabilities, System maintains system management, personal center and AI copywriting; modules must not directly modify the language package of another module.

Backend error directory loaded by `kratos-core/resource/i18n`. Proto `buf.validate`'s `id/message` and explicit `WithMessageKey` in Go must be defined in `zh-CN.json`, other languages ​​keep the same keys and placeholders. The check command is:

```bash
make i18n-check
```

The error keeps the existing `code/reason` externally, only adds the stable `message_key/message_args` in the metadata, and renders `message` according to the request language by the response boundary.

## Front-end and back-end Key naming convention

The front-end and back-end use the same set of layered ideas, but retain the naming sources of their respective code ecosystems: the front-end fixed copy generates business paths from component names, and back-end errors generate business paths from Proto package and Service. Key is a stable technical identifier that does not contain Chinese characters and is not named based on translation results.

### Front-end fixed copywriting

Front-end fixed copy uses the following format:

```text
<模块>.<组件业务路径>.<文案类型>.<名称>
```

The component business path comes from `defineOptions.name`, split the PascalCase name into a lowercase dot path:

```text
BaseDict      -> base.dict
BaseDictItem  -> base.dict.item
CodeGenTable  -> code.gen.table
BaseTenant    -> base.tenant
```

Example:

```text
system.base.dict.title.create
system.base.dict.field.created_at
system.base.dict.dialog.confirm_status
system.base.dict.message.create_success
system.code.gen.table.field.page_type
```

Copywriting types use fixed sets: `title`, `field`, `section`, `action`, `placeholder`, `validation`, KR ATOSTOKEN0006, `message`, `error`, `status`, `value`, `tooltip`, `empty`. Use `snake_case` uniformly for names and fields, such as `confirm_status`, `created_at`, `create_success`.

For copywriting that is truly cross-business reusable, use `common.*`, without adding business paths repeatedly:

```text
common.action.create
common.field.created_at
common.validation.required_input
```

The logical key of the front-end language package uses the above dotted path. The current runtime and verification code are still read according to the flat key; if the JSON is changed to a nested object, the synchronization script, module registration and generated product must be modified simultaneously, and the JSON shape cannot be changed manually.

### Backend error message

Backend `message_key` uses the following format:

```text
<package 去掉版本>.<Service 业务路径>.<操作或对象>.<字段>.<规则>
```

Remove the version number from the Proto package, remove `Service` from the Service and use PascalCase to split it into a lowercase dotted path:

```text
system.admin.v1 + BaseDictService -> system.admin.base.dict
system.admin.v1 + CodeGenTableService -> system.admin.code.gen.table
base.v1 + LoginService -> base.login
```

Example:

```text
system.admin.base.dict.entity.name.required
system.admin.base.dict.create.name.required
system.admin.base.dict.update.id.required
system.admin.code.gen.table.field.page_type.required
```

`entity` represents the verification of the entity itself, and other values ​​represent specific operations. Field names and rule names use Proto style `snake_case`. Rule names should remain stable, with priority being given to fixed vocabulary such as `required`, `max_length`, `min_length`, `format`, `pattern`, `positive`, `non_negative`, `unique`, `supported`, etc.

Generic error is not bound to a specific Service:

```text
common.error.invalid_argument
common.error.permission_denied
```

The version number `v1` does not enter the key; `message_key` will be returned with the error response and is an external stable contract. The rename must be synchronized with Proto, Go, all language directories and the caller.

### Correspondence between front and back ends

The front and back ends are not required to use exactly the same key, but the business paths should be able to correspond to each other:

```text
前端：system.base.dict.dialog.confirm_status
后端：system.admin.base.dict.create.name.required
```

Dynamic menu, dictionary, configuration and other database translations use the target type and number of `base_i18n`, and do not reuse the fixed copy key.

## Dynamic resource translation

Dynamic resources share a translation table `base_i18n`, and the target resources are distinguished by `target_type`:

| `target_type` | Main table | Translatable fields |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `1` | `base_config` | Text and rich text configuration values |
| `2` | `base_config` | System configuration name |
| `3` | `base_dict` | dictionary name |
| `4` | `base_dict_item` | Dictionary entry label |
| `5` | `base_menu` | Menu title |
| `6` | `base_job` | Scheduled task name |
| `7` | `base_migration` | Migration Instructions |

`base_dict.code` and `base_dict_item.value` are stable business identifiers and do not enter the translation table; the dictionary name and dictionary item label correspond to `3` and `4` respectively, and the system configuration name and value correspond to `2` and `1` respectively.

When creating or updating dynamic resources, the main language text is written to the main table; manually entered non-main language text is written directly to `base_i18n`. Uninputted languages ​​are supplemented by translation tasks, and existing non-empty translations will not be overwritten; the main language is not repeatedly saved in the translation table, and falls back to the main table if missing.

Fixed translations of built-in menus, dictionaries, dictionary entries and system configurations are in version `i18n.<locale>.up.sql`. The migration uses idempotent `INSERT IGNORE`, which will not overwrite the data that has been maintained; the executed version cannot be repaired by rewriting the file, and a new version must be added for migration.

## Machine Translation

Machine translation when the service is run through `kratos-kit/translator` Press `backend/configs/translator.yaml` to select Provider. The entries include:

- Management side `BaseI18nService.DraftBaseI18n`: Generate and save a single translation for a saved menu, dictionary, dictionary item or configuration.
- After the menu, dictionary, dictionary item and configuration are successfully created or updated: the resource message is first delivered to the asynchronous translation queue; when the queue consumption fails, the scheduled task scans the pending translations.
- When the management editor submits empty text, or if a vacant translation is found when hovering the list name, it will be filled in immediately through the same interface; the manually filled non-empty translation remains unchanged.

Batch language packs and migration translations are generated by `make i18n-locale I18N_LOCALE=<locale>` calling independent scripts and are not part of the normal service request link.

The translation interface is turned off by default and can be turned on through `translator.enabled=true`, `I18N_DRAFT_ENABLED=true` or application metadata. The server reads the controlled source text, with the target language limited to the enabled languages, calling serially and using the HTTP timeout configured by `translator.timeout` (default 8 seconds); existing non-null translations will not be overwritten. System configuration names, text, and rich text type values ​​will enter machine translation, and images and Boolean values ​​will not be sent out.

Provider is for translation only and cannot be used for login, error responses, plain CRUD or arbitrary text translation agents. When the Provider is unavailable, fixed language packs, existing translations, and primary language fallbacks must still work properly.

## Code generation

The code generator reuses the `common.*` general template in `backend/internal/i18n/assets/<locale>.json`, and uses `system.code.gen.*` to save the code to generate exclusive process copy and terminology; at the same time, it reads business names and field names from table-level and field-level `i18n_config`. The generation page will write the stable keys of all compilation-time languages; when the non-main language lacks necessary configurations, the missing items should be completed and displayed in the preview before official generation.

Generators must not write new Chinese UI copy directly into Vue, Proto or menu SQL. The generated results belong to the key range of the current code generation object and cannot cover other modules or manually maintained translations.

## Database migration

New language or new translation uses higher version directory:

```text
backend/migration/assets/vX.Y.Z/mysql/
├── README.md
├── README.<locale>.md
├── language.up.sql
└── i18n.<locale>.up.sql
```

`make i18n-sync I18N_MIGRATION_VERSION=vX.Y.Z` generates `base_language` initialization record; `make i18n-locale I18N_LOCALE=<locale>` writes the dynamic translation SQL into the current `v0.0.1` by default. If a new version directory is required, pass in `I18N_MIGRATION_VERSION=vX.Y.Z`. The generator only creates `README.md` when the directory does not have a description. The description of the existing directory needs to be manually updated according to the actual script; the existing `README.<locale>.md` should also be updated simultaneously. Empty files are not created when there is no corresponding language description.

The enablement status, ordering, and primary language of `base_language` are deployment configurations and should not be forcibly overridden by re-executing the language pack sync script. Executed migration files cannot be modified in the production environment.

## Verification Checklist

After adding or modifying a language, check at least:

1. `make i18n-check` and `make i18n-sync` passed.
2. The key and placeholder verification of the management end, uni-app, and Taro passed.
3. When the language interface fails, the three terminals can still use the compile-time fallback list.
4. Language selection can be restored before logging in, after logging in, refreshing and reopening the app.
5. Menus, dictionaries and configurations can all fall back correctly when there are non-empty translations, missing translations and primary language switching.
6. The reason for verification, authentication, permission and resource errors remains unchanged, only the message is localized.
7. The type check and lint of `go test ./...` and affected workspaces passed.

For step-by-step commands, file lists, and troubleshooting for adding new languages, see [Internationalization Language Expansion Guide](国际化语言扩展指南.md).

# Internationalization Language Extension Guide

This article is the implementation manual for the new language. The current fixed language set is `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `en-US`, `ja-JP`. When adding a new language, the compile-time language package determines "what language the code can render", and the `base_language` data only determines "what languages ​​are enabled in the current deployment, how to sort them, and which language is the main language of dynamic resources."

## First understand the two levels of responsibilities

| Layer | Authoritative Source | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Compilation period | Backend error directory, three-end core/System JSON, code generation directory | Language whitelist, fixed UI copywriting, error copywriting, code generation template |
| Runtime | `base_language` table | Language name, native name, enabled status, sorting, primary language |

Therefore, just adding a language record to the database cannot make the new language appear on the page; just adding front-end JSON cannot make the dynamic menu, dictionary and login page read the language. The two layers must be synchronized.

## Files to be added

Each language code must use the JSON file with the same name in the following seven language pack directories, and the code generator copy is also merged in the backend language file:

| Table of Contents | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `backend/internal/i18n/assets` | Backend Error Message Catalog |
| `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/locales` | Management base and public copy |
| `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/locales` | Management System Copywriter |
| `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/locales` | uni-app base and public copy |
| `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales` | uni-app System copywriter |
| `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/locales` | Taro base and public copy |
| `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales` | Taro System Copywriter |
JSON keys, placeholders, and namespaces must remain unchanged. `common.language.<locale>` is used to display the language name offline and can be supplemented; the runtime name is read from the database first, so adding a new language does not require modifying the existing language package or TypeScript registration code.

## Key naming quick check

When adding fixed copy, first determine the module and component it belongs to, and then name it according to unified rules:

```text
前端：<模块>.<defineOptions.name 转换路径>.<文案类型>.<名称>
后端：<package 去掉版本>.<Service 转换路径>.<操作或对象>.<字段>.<规则>
```

Example:

```text
BaseDict -> system.base.dict.dialog.confirm_status
BaseDictService / system.admin.v1 -> system.admin.base.dict.create.name.required
CodeGenTable -> system.code.gen.table.field.page_type
```

The component name and service name are split into lowercase dot paths according to PascalCase; the end names, fields and rules use `snake_case`. Use `common.*` for cross-business public copywriting and `common.error.*` for common back-end errors. The backend key does not contain `v1`; renaming `message_key` requires synchronization of Proto, Go and all language directories.

## Standard process

### 1. Select language code

Use BCP 47 form, such as `de-DE`, `pt-BR`. The language code must be consistent in all directories, and two representations of `de` and `de-DE` cannot appear at the same time. The code needs to be parsable by Core's `resource/i18n` language resource directory, and the management side's Day.js and Element Plus locale dependencies can find the corresponding region or basic language mapping.

### 2. Add language pack

Using `zh-CN.json` as the key benchmark, add `<locale>.json` to the seven directories in the above table, and translate values ​​item by item:

```text
backend/internal/i18n/assets/de-DE.json
frontend/admin/packages/core/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales/de-DE.json
```

The code generator copy is written directly to `backend/internal/i18n/assets/<locale>.json`, using the `system.code.gen.*` prefix; when adding a new code generation copy, all back-end language files are modified simultaneously, and the placeholder set is retained.

`common.language.<locale>` can be written to the management-side Core language package, which is used to display the language name offline and generate the initial name for `base_language` migration; the runtime language name, sorting and enabling status are still subject to database records. Adding a new language does not require modifying the language name key in the existing language pack.

`{name}`, `{field}`, `{max}`, `{{.Value}}` placeholders as well as URL, permission paths, dictionary code/value and HTML/Markdown tags must be preserved during translation. Do not translate routes `name`, `path`, `component`, or API paths.

### 3. Run the synchronization script

Execute in the warehouse root directory:

```bash
make i18n-sync
```

The script checks for:

- Whether the file sets in the seven language pack directories are consistent;
- Whether the key set and placeholder of each language pack are consistent;
- Whether the code generator language catalog fields are complete;
- Whether there are available mappings for Day.js and Element Plus on the management side.

After passing the check, the script generates the following files. Do not edit them manually:

- `src/locales/generated.ts` for six front-end packages;
- Management side Day.js, Element Plus locale mapping;
- `language.up.sql` and description files are generated when passing in a migration version.

### 4. Generate database language records

The current warehouse uses `v0.0.1` for migration; this version is written when generating language initialization records:

```bash
make i18n-sync I18N_MIGRATION_VERSION=v0.0.1
```

The migration generated by the script is only responsible for supplementing the `base_language` record. Using `INSERT IGNORE` will not overwrite the enabled status, sorting and main language configuration of the existing deployment. Check the migration version directory before submitting and make sure `language.up.sql` is submitted together with the documentation.

If the deployment does not want the language to be enabled immediately, `base_language.status` can be adjusted to be disabled after migration; the main language can only be switched through the management side language configuration or database configuration, and cannot be changed through the front-end language package.

### 5. Prepare dynamic resource translation (optional)

Fixed UI and backend bugs Once the package is complete, new languages ​​can fall back to the main language at runtime. To provide fixed translations for built-in menus, dictionaries, dictionary items, and system configurations, you can use batch scripts to generate language packs and dynamic translation data:

```bash
I18N_OFFLINE=1 \
make i18n-locale I18N_LOCALE=de-DE
```

`I18N_OFFLINE=1` can be removed for online translation. This command is written to the corresponding language pack, `i18n.de-DE.up.sql` and description files under `v0.0.1` by default. Migration only writes non-empty fixed text, and existing values ​​will not be overwritten. If the language pack has been manually completed, maintain `i18n.<locale>.up.sql` directly, and do not use this command to overwrite the manual translation.

Dynamic resources can also be edited in the management-side internationalization maintenance page. The main language text with content in the form can be translated instantly individually or in batches. The Draft interface only returns a single translation and does not write it into the unified internationalization table; manual input will be directly saved to the unified internationalization table. Empty translations enter the asynchronous internationalization queue after the resource is successfully created or updated. When submitting empty texts, they will also be completed according to the save logic. Failure messages will be scanned again by the scheduled task, and existing non-empty translations will not be overwritten. The internationalization interface is only available when `I18N_DRAFT_ENABLED=true` or equivalent application metadata is enabled. The system configuration name and text and rich text type values ​​support internationalization. Pictures and Boolean values ​​are not sent out; when the runtime value is missing, it falls back to the main language.

### 6. Verify and submit

It is recommended to execute before submitting:

```bash
make i18n-check
make i18n-sync
git diff --check

cd backend && go test ./...
cd ../frontend/admin && pnpm type:check && pnpm lint:oxlint
cd ../uni-app && pnpm tsc && pnpm lint
cd ../taro-app && pnpm tsc && pnpm lint
```

Confirm that the new language is available in the following scenarios: first startup, language switching before login, switching after login, refresh recovery, dynamic menu, dictionary display, verification error and main language fallback when dynamic translation is missing.

## Contents that do not need to be modified

Adding new languages ​​does not require modification:

- Go locale constants, backend service registration and error localization code;
- Three terminals locale runtime, module registration and request encapsulation;
- Proto, RPC makefile and menu routing code.

These runtime files read the front-end registration files generated by compile-time language packs and synchronization scripts; the runtime enabled languages, default languages, and ordering are provided by the `base_language` database record. Only when a new language exposes that the basic library does not have locale mapping, the language package structure requires new fields, or the business does add a new translation key, corresponding dependencies or code changes are required.

## Troubleshooting

| Phenomenon | Check |
| --- | --- |
| `语言集合不一致` | Whether all seven language pack directories have the same name JSON |
| `语言键集合不一致` | Compare key and placeholder with same directory `zh-CN.json` |
| `代码生成器语言键集合不一致` | Are the `system.code.gen.*` keys and placeholders of each backend language file consistent |
| `缺少组件语言映射` | Does Day.js/Element Plus provide this regional or base language file |
| The language can be switched but the name is empty | Check the `base_language` record, or add `common.language.<locale>` |
| Menu/Dictionary still shows the main language | Check whether there is a non-empty record in the unified translation table, and whether the request is sent `Accept-Language` |

For the complete architecture description, see [Internationalization Final Plan](国际化最终方案.md); for local constraints of the language pack directory, see the README of each directory.

# 安全策略与运维任务

## 登录安全

登录失败锁定仍按租户、账号和客户端地址隔离。部署时可通过环境变量增加来源策略：

| 变量 | 格式 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LOGIN_POLICY_IP_BLACKLIST` | 逗号分隔 IP/CIDR | 命中即拒绝 |
| `LOGIN_POLICY_IP_WHITELIST` | 逗号分隔 IP/CIDR | 配置后仅允许命中地址 |
| `LOGIN_POLICY_TIME_WINDOWS` | `HH:MM-HH:MM` | 当前时间落入窗口时拒绝，支持跨午夜 |
| `LOGIN_POLICY_DEVICE_BLACKLIST` | 逗号分隔设备标识 | 匹配 `X-Device-ID` 或 User-Agent |
| `LOGIN_POLICY_DEVICE_WHITELIST` | 逗号分隔设备标识 | 配置后仅允许命中设备 |

登录失败锁定还可通过 `LOGIN_FAILURE_MAX_ATTEMPTS`（默认 `5`）和 `LOGIN_FAILURE_WINDOW_MINUTES`（默认 `15`）调整阈值与窗口。

密码新增、重置和个人修改统一校验长度及四类字符中至少三类。可用以下变量调整规则：

| 变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH` | `8` | 最小字符数 |
| `PASSWORD_HISTORY_COUNT` | `3` | 历史口令禁止重复的保留数量 |
| `PASSWORD_MAX_AGE_DAYS` | `90` | 口令有效期；登录时超过期限会要求修改 |

## 当前会话

`BaseSessionService` 提供当前会话查看和撤销全部会话接口。当前令牌实现按用户维护一个有效访问令牌，因此“全部会话”与撤销当前用户令牌等价；在底层令牌组件支持多会话索引后再扩展为逐设备撤销。

## 审计日志

Core 将请求和策略事件写入 `base.audit.event`，再由 Core 消费者分别落入 `base_api_log` 和 `base_policy_evaluation_log`；Admin 业务事件写入独立 `admin.audit.event`，由 Admin 消费者落库。六张完整日志模型和自动迁移仍由 Admin 提供，六类日志全部异步入库，队列失败不在请求线程同步写库。普通租户不授予日志菜单和查询权限。

配置完整性密钥并启用任务后，每天 03:30 执行 `system.admin.BaseAuditRetention`，按表把超过保留期的记录写入 JSONL 后删除在线记录：

- `AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS`：默认 `180`，设置为 `0` 或负数时停用；
- `AUDIT_ARCHIVE_DIR`：默认 `./data/audit-archive`。
- `AUDIT_ARCHIVE_INTEGRITY_KEY`：必填的独立完整性密钥；未配置时归档任务拒绝运行。

归档目录应挂载到受控存储，并由运维侧做加密、校验和备份。归档任务只在文件同步成功后删除在线记录。

## 数据库备份

每天 02:00 执行 `system.admin.BaseBackup`。任务默认关闭，启用时至少设置：

```bash
BACKUP_ENABLED=true
MYSQLDUMP_DATABASE=kratos_admin
MYSQLDUMP_HOST=127.0.0.1
MYSQLDUMP_PORT=3306
MYSQLDUMP_USER=backup
MYSQLDUMP_PASSWORD=***
BACKUP_INTEGRITY_KEY=***
BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY=***
```

`BACKUP_INTEGRITY_KEY` 和 `BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY` 为必填的独立密钥，任务会使用 AES-256 加密备份，并同时写入 SHA-256 和 HMAC 校验文件；恢复脚本会拒绝缺少或校验失败的备份。可选变量：`MYSQLDUMP_BIN`、`OPENSSL_BIN`、`BACKUP_DIR`（默认 `./data/backups`）、`BACKUP_GZIP`（默认 `true`）和 `BACKUP_RETENTION_COUNT`（默认 `7`）。密码通过 `MYSQL_PWD` 传给子进程，不会出现在命令行参数中。恢复前必须停止写入并确认目标数据库，使用仓库内 `scripts/restore_backup.sh` 执行。

OAuth 客户端凭据使用独立的 `OAUTH_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` 加密存储，必须由 Secret Manager 注入且长度至少 16 个字符，可用 `OAUTH_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY_ID` 标识当前密钥版本；JWT 密钥轮换不会复用该密钥。
升级到该策略后，历史明文 OAuth 客户端需通过管理端“轮换客户端凭据”重新生成密钥，系统不再兼容旧明文凭据。

## 对象存储

文件服务复用 Core 的 OSS 适配器，支持 `local`、`aliyun`、`minio` 和 `s3`。单实例开发默认使用 `local`；多实例部署应切换到 MinIO/S3 兼容存储，并为每个租户配置独立路径前缀和最小权限凭据。Compose 中的 MinIO 使用 `object-storage` profile 启动。

documents.content:
# 开放授权协议设计

开放授权用于外部开发接口，不替代管理端用户登录，也不复用三方登录 `OauthService`。外部开发接口使用 `/api/v1/oauth/` 路径前缀；管理端通过 `OauthClientService` 维护客户端。

当前仓库只提供授权客户端管理和令牌签发，不内置 `/api/v1/oauth/` 业务接口。接入方需要通过外部 Go 模块贡献带有该路径前缀的 Proto、OpenAPI 和服务；未接入外部业务模块时，管理端的可授权 API 列表为空，客户端不能用于调用业务接口。

管理端页面位于 `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/views/base/oauth-client`，可查询授权 API、创建/编辑/删除客户端、启停客户端和复制完整凭据。完整凭据只在管理端按需读取，`client_secret` 和 `crypto_key` 不进入列表响应。

## 数据模型

只新增 `oauth_client` 表：

- `client_id`、`client_secret`：客户端凭据。
- `tenant_id`：客户端绑定租户，所有客户端数据和 Token 权限使用该租户的数据权限。
- `crypto_type`、`crypto_key`：调用方协议加密元数据，由开放授权 HTTP Filter 在请求绑定前读取并执行加解密。
- `ip_whitelist`：逗号分隔的精确 IP 或 CIDR。
- `api`：允许访问的 `base_api.operation` JSON 数组，不建立关联表，和菜单 API 字段保持一致。
- `status`：客户端启停状态。

## 协议流程

1. 客户端向 `POST /api/v1/base/oauth/client/token` 提交 `client_id`、`client_secret` 和可选的 `grant_type=client_credentials`。
2. 服务校验凭据和客户端状态，使用现有 JWT/Redis 令牌管理器签发 Bearer Token；Token 的角色编码为 `client_id`，`uid/rid` 使用负数客户端身份空间，避免与用户令牌缓存键冲突。绑定默认租户时使用 OAuth 专用租户编码，避免默认租户的跨租户管理语义绕过数据隔离。
3. 管理端创建或修改客户端时，将 JSON API 列表转换成默认租户下该客户端角色的 Casbin operation 策略。
4. 客户端携带 Bearer Token 调用 `/api/v1/oauth/` 接口。HTTP OAuth middleware 只在令牌角色命中 `oauth_client.client_id` 时执行，分别校验客户端身份、状态、来源 IP 和当前 operation + HTTP method 是否在 API JSON 白名单中。
5. 普通用户令牌不会命中客户端表，直接沿用现有用户认证和 Casbin 链路。

## 数据加解密

客户端创建后，管理端会按算法生成匹配格式的 `crypto_key`：

| `crypto_type` | `crypto_key` 格式 | 密文格式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sm4` | Base64 编码的 16 字节密钥 | Base64(`12 字节 nonce || ciphertext || 16 字节 GCM tag`) |
| `aes` | Base64 编码的 32 字节密钥 | Base64(`12 字节 nonce || ciphertext || 16 字节 GCM tag`) |

调用顺序如下：

1. 调用 `POST /api/v1/base/oauth/client/token`，使用 `client_id` 和 `client_secret` 获取 Bearer Token。
2. 对 `/api/v1/oauth/` 下的 `POST`、`PUT`、`PATCH` 请求，将正常 JSON 请求体按客户端算法加密后 Base64 编码，作为整个 HTTP body 发送；`GET`、`DELETE` 的 query/path 参数保持明文。
3. 请求必须携带 `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`。服务端先验证客户端 Token，再读取客户端算法和密钥，在 Proto HTTP body bind 之前解密，因此业务 Service 收到的仍是普通请求对象。
4. 成功的 2xx 响应会加密。当前 ProtoJSON 直出响应整体编码为 JSON 字符串形式的 Base64 密文；如果接入方使用 `{"code":200,"data":...}` 包装响应，则只加密 `data` 字段，`code`、`msg` 保持明文。
5. 4xx/5xx 错误响应不加密，便于定位凭据、IP、权限或密文格式错误。

HTTP Filter 在 `backend/internal/module/module.go` 注册，HTTP 包装实现位于 `backend/internal/server/middleware/oauth/crypto.go`，算法实现位于其 `crypto/` 子目录。它位于生成的 Proto HTTP 路由外层；不能只使用 operation Service middleware，因为后者执行时请求体已经完成绑定。

## 边界

API 选项、保存校验和运行时拦截器都会拒绝非 `/api/v1/oauth/` 的接口，避免把管理端、应用端或基础登录接口授权给开发客户端。停用、修改白名单或删除客户端后，新的请求立即受影响；删除同时清理 Casbin 策略。

客户端只需要保存管理端返回的 `client_id`、`client_secret`、`crypto_type` 和 `crypto_key`，不要把 `crypto_key` 写入前端仓库或日志。更新客户端算法会重新生成密钥，旧密钥立即失效；客户端应重新读取凭据后再发起调用。

documents.name: API Parameter Validation Design.md
documents.content:
# Interface parameter verification

The backend uses `buf.validate` to declare rules, and Core's `server/middleware/validate.go` calls protovalidate in HTTP and gRPC business processing. When the verification fails, `INVALID_ARGUMENT` is returned, and the response boundary is localized to `message` of the first violation according to the request language; the error reason and metadata remain stable.

`rules` of `ProForm` on the management side is used for real-time interactive prompts and cannot replace server-side verification; constraints on both ends should express the same business rules.

## Proto writing method

```proto
import "buf/validate/validate.proto";
import "gnostic/openapi/v3/annotations.proto";

message ExampleForm {
  string name = 1 [
    (gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "名称"},
    (buf.validate.field).cel = {
      id: "example.name.required"
      message: "请输入名称"
      expression: "this.size() > 0"
    },
    (buf.validate.field).cel = {
      id: "example.name.max_len"
      message: "名称不能超过 30 个字符"
      expression: "this.size() <= 30"
    }
  ]; // 名称
}

message CreateExampleRequest {
  ExampleForm example = 1 [
    (gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "示例表单"},
    (buf.validate.field).required = true
  ]; // 示例表单
}
```

The rule ID uses the stable `<resource>.<field>.<rule>`, and Chinese messages are directed to users. Don't rely on the generator's default English errors.

## Common rules

| Constraints | Proto |
| --- | --- |
| String required | CEL `this.size() > 0` |
| Maximum length | CEL `this.size() <= 30` |
| Positive ID | CEL `this > 0` |
| Nested message required | `(buf.validate.field).required = true` |
| Enumeration is legal | `(buf.validate.field).enum = {defined_only: true}` |
| The list is not empty | CEL `this.size() > 0` |
| Unique list | CEL `this.unique()` |
| Email | `(buf.validate.field).string.email = true` |
| URL | `(buf.validate.field).string.uri = true` |
| Regular | `(buf.validate.field).string.pattern = "..."` |
| value collection | `(buf.validate.field).string.in = ["a", "b"]` |

Cross-field rules are written at the message level:

```proto
message PeriodForm {
  option (buf.validate.message).cel = {
    id: "period.range"
    message: "结束时间不能早于开始时间"
    expression: "this.end_at >= this.start_at"
  };

  int64 start_at = 1 [(gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "开始时间"}]; // 开始时间
  int64 end_at = 2 [(gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "结束时间"}]; // 结束时间
}
```

Uniqueness, foreign key existence, tenant permissions, protected resources and state transfer depend on the database or current identity, must be placed in biz, and cannot be disguised as format verification.

## ProForm corresponding

```ts
const fields: ProFormField[] = [
  {
    prop: "name",
    label: "名称",
    component: "input",
    props: { maxlength: 30, showWordLimit: true },
    rules: [
      { required: true, message: "请输入名称", trigger: "blur" },
      { max: 30, message: "名称不能超过 30 个字符", trigger: "blur" }
    ]
  }
];
```

- `required`, length, range, format and number of lists are provided with instant prompts on the front-end.
- `maxlength`, `min`, `max` and other control restrictions should be consistent with rules and Proto.
- The business verification message returned by the backend is still the final result, and the frontend must not skip error processing just because it passes the form verification.
- The `optional` field will only execute the format rules when it has a value; the front-end non-required fields should not add `required` unconditionally.

## Change Check

1. Modify Proto annotation, OpenAPI description and `buf.validate`.
2. Execute `make -C backend api` and `make i18n-openapi`.
3. Execute `make -C frontend ts-admin`, `make -C frontend ts-uni-app` or `make -C frontend ts-taro-app` according to the consumer end; execute `make -C frontend ts` when three terminals need to be generated at one time.
4. Synchronize ProForm rules, control restrictions and interface error display.
5. Perform back-end testing and corresponding front-end type checking.

Generated Go, OpenAPI and TypeScript RPCs without manual modification.

documents.content:
# 数据库与初始化数据

## 当前数据源

系统默认使用 MySQL 数据库 `kratos_admin`，基础配置位于 `backend/configs/data.yaml`，开发环境差异位于 `backend/configs/data.dev.yaml`。Redis 用于验证码、一次性密码密钥、Token 等缓存状态。

`data.database` 表示单一默认数据源；`data.databases` 可声明多个命名数据源。默认数据源保存系统表以及所有模块的 `base_migration` 执行记录。

## 建表和迁移

启动顺序为：

1. 创建全部 GORM 客户端。
2. 对 `enable_migrate: true` 的客户端执行注册模型的 `AutoMigrate`。
3. 加载模块迁移资源，按依赖、版本、数据库类型和数据源执行 `.up.sql`。
4. 将迁移目录中的现有多语言说明同步到统一翻译表。
5. 完成 OpenAPI 接口数据、租户角色菜单和 Casbin 策略同步。

`enable_migrate` 只控制 GORM 自动建表，不会关闭版本化 SQL。全新环境应为默认数据源启用它，否则 `base_migration` 等表可能尚不存在。

## 资源结构

当前内置资源：

```text
backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/mysql/
├── README.md
├── README.en-US.md
├── README.ja-JP.md
├── README.zh-TW.md
├── base_area.up.sql
├── default_data.up.sql
├── i18n.en-US.up.sql
├── i18n.zh-TW.up.sql
└── i18n.ja-JP.up.sql
```

MFA 认证方式拆分使用 GORM 自动迁移创建 `base_user_mfa`、`base_user_mfa_totp`、`base_user_mfa_webauthn` 和 `base_user_mfa_recovery` 表；开放授权客户端使用 GORM 自动迁移创建 `oauth_client` 表。默认 MFA 策略、认证方式、开放授权菜单/API 和管理员权限直接写入 `v0.0.1` 的初始化脚本。

目录规则：

```text
assets/<version>/<database-type>/<feature>.up.sql
assets/<version>/<database-type>/<feature>.down.sql          # 可选
assets/<version>/<database-type>/README.md
assets/<version>/<database-type>/README.<locale>.md           # 可选
assets/<version>/<database-type>/<data-source>/<feature>.up.sql
assets/<version>/<database-type>/<data-source>/README.md
assets/<version>/<database-type>/<data-source>/README.<locale>.md  # 可选
```

当前仓库内置并验证的是 `mysql`。数据库类型目录下的直系文件属于 `default` 数据源；一级子目录是命名数据源，必须与配置名称一致。需要接入其他数据库类型时，必须先确认对应驱动、模型迁移和 SQL 方言，再新增迁移目录。脚本按文件名排序执行，`base_migration.description` 只读取同目录的 `README.md`。

`README.<locale>.md` 以 `base_migration.id` 为目标 ID、以 `I18N_TARGET_TYPE_BASE_MIGRATION_DESCRIPTION` 为目标类型同步到 `base_i18n`。语言文件存在时以文件内容更新对应译文；不存在时不新增、不修改该语言记录。详情接口优先返回请求语言的译文，缺失时回退 `base_migration.description`。

迁移记录唯一标识包含模块、数据源和版本。一个版本内任一升级脚本失败会回滚该版本并阻止服务启动，修复后重启会重试未记录版本。

## 初始化内容

`default_data.up.sql` 与同版本语言脚本共同提供：

- 默认租户、部门、岗位、角色和 `super`、`admin` 开发账号。
- 系统配置、字典、菜单、按钮和服务方法权限关系。
- 管理端 System 页面、AI、代码生成、API 文档和应用端所需权限入口。
- MFA 策略与认证方式字典，以及开放授权客户端管理菜单和 API 选项权限。

`default_data.up.sql` 负责语言记录、默认业务数据、菜单和权限；同版本 `i18n.{locale}.up.sql` 通过 `base_i18n.target_type` 提供菜单、字典、字典项、系统配置名称/值和定时任务名称的非主语言译文。Core 在迁移执行完成后将 `README.<locale>.md` 写入 `base_i18n`，Admin 详情接口直接查询该表。主语言由 `base_language.is_primary` 配置，主表保存主语言文本，其他启用语言保存到统一翻译表。翻译表及代码生成 `i18n_config` 字段由 GORM `AutoMigrate` 创建。

`base_area.up.sql` 提供地区基础数据。初始化 SQL 使用 `INSERT IGNORE`，遇到已有唯一键记录时跳过，不覆盖已有数据。

启动时 `BaseApiCase.InitializeOpenAPI` 根据已注册 OpenAPI 重建接口元数据，随后同步租户管理员菜单并重建 Casbin 规则。因此修改 Proto 路径或菜单 API 列表时，必须同时重新生成 OpenAPI 并更新版本化 SQL。

## 新环境

```sql
CREATE DATABASE kratos_admin CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
```

启动后端后，默认开发账号为：

- `super / 112233`
- `admin / 112233`

这些凭据只用于本地初始化，部署前必须修改。

## 存量升级

- 不修改已经发布并执行的版本目录，新增更高版本。
- 结构变更、数据修复、菜单和权限调整放在同一功能版本中。
- 新增语言先按[国际化语言扩展指南](国际化语言扩展指南.md)生成语言包和 `language.up.sql`；动态固定译文另生成 `i18n.<locale>.up.sql`。
- SQL 保持幂等，避免 `TRUNCATE`、无条件全表更新或删除。
- 生产执行前备份并验证回滚策略；需要回退时显式提供 `.down.sql`。

documents.content:
# 日志与审计设计

> 状态：六类查询、表结构、菜单、Core 审计入库和 Admin 业务审计入库已实施；归档任务和故障演练持续完善。
> 日期：2026-08-29。
> 本设计不兼容旧的 `base_log` 查询接口，不迁移历史日志；实施时直接以 `v0.0.1` 的全新初始化数据为准。

## 1. 设计结论

日志审计拆分为六张互相独立的表，不建立公共日志父表，也不再通过一个 `audit_type` 字段把不同事实混在一起：

```text
base_login_log
base_api_log
base_operation_log
base_data_access_log
base_permission_log
base_policy_evaluation_log
```

每张表只记录一种不可变事实：

| 表 | 回答的问题 | 典型生产者 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `base_login_log` | 谁以什么方式尝试认证，结果如何 | 登录、退出、刷新令牌、MFA、OAuth |
| `base_api_log` | 哪个协议请求发生了什么 | HTTP/gRPC 统一访问中间件 |
| `base_operation_log` | 谁对哪个业务对象做了什么 | 业务 Case 或操作审计拦截器 |

## 2. 共同约束

### 2.1 事件不可变

- 审计表只追加，不提供编辑接口。
- 管理端只提供分页、详情和筛选，不提供新增、修改、删除按钮。
- 不使用 `updated_at`；`created_at` 表示落库时间，`occurred_at` 表示事件发生时间。
- 保留期到期后由后台归档或按时间批量清理，不通过普通租户 API 删除。
- 日志写入失败只记录指标和运行日志，不能改变原业务请求或鉴权结果。

### 2.2 租户和主体

- `tenant_id` 用于和当前业务表关联、筛选和数据隔离。
- `tenant_code` 必须同时保留，因为当前 Casbin 使用租户编码作为策略域。
- `user_id`、`user_name`、`role_id`、`role_code` 是事件发生时的快照，不能依赖后续关联表恢复历史信息。
- 登录失败可能无法解析出用户或租户 ID，此时允许主体字段为空，但应保存输入的租户编码、账号名和客户端信息。
- 普通租户没有日志菜单、查询 API 或详情 API 权限；平台管理员才可查询跨租户记录。

### 2.3 敏感数据

禁止记录密码、访问令牌、刷新令牌、私钥、验证码答案、完整 Cookie 和未脱敏请求体。

- 请求体、响应体只保留脱敏摘要；大字段不落库。
- 业务快照只保留允许审计的字段，密码、Token、密钥、验证码等字段统一删除或替换为 `[REDACTED]`。
- 策略输入保存 `input_hash` 和必要的脱敏摘要，不保存完整用户属性、请求头或 SQL 条件。
- 数据访问日志中的 SQL 只能保存脱敏后的文本和指纹；策略评估日志不保存 `scope_sql`。

## 5. 事件写入职责

```text
认证流程              -> base_login_log
协议请求中间件         -> base_api_log
业务 Case              -> base_operation_log
数据访问/导出层        -> base_data_access_log
角色/菜单/API 权限变更  -> base_permission_log
鉴权 Engine 装饰器      -> base_policy_evaluation_log
```

### 5.1 请求链路

同一个请求可以产生多条不同事实，但每条只写入所属表：

```text
请求进入
  -> base_api_log
  -> base_policy_evaluation_log
  -> base_data_access_log（实际访问数据时）
  -> base_operation_log（实际发生业务变更时）
```

权限配置变更另外写 `base_permission_log`；它不是普通业务操作的替代品。

### 5.2 策略评估记录粒度

- `IsAuthorized` 每次实际引擎调用产生一条记录。
- 多租户或多主体循环按实际评估租户/主体记录，保留同一 `request_id` 和 `trace_id`。
- `FilterAuthorizedPairs`、`FilterAuthorizedProjects` 记录聚合结果，不为每个候选项单独写行。
- 默认记录拒绝和异常；允许记录通过配置开启。安全审计环境可以开启全部记录。
- 写入采用异步缓冲或批量队列，日志故障不能让鉴权失败。

### 5.3 Core 审计事件处理（已完成）

Core 通过 `audit.Pipeline` 将访问与策略事实投递到 `base.audit.event`，再由 Core 消费者分别写入 `base_api_log` 和 `base_policy_evaluation_log`。Admin 业务中间件使用独立 `admin.audit.event` 队列，由 Admin 消费者写入登录、操作、数据访问和权限日志。Admin 继续提供六张完整 GORM 模型并负责自动迁移，Core 只使用 API/策略日志的精简内部模型写入，不注册或迁移模型。

不得出现以下状态：

- 同一请求同时写入 `base_log` 和 `base_api_log`；
- `base_log` 继续作为“系统日志”菜单展示六类日志；
- 新的策略评估记录通过 `base_log.audit_type` 伪装成授权日志。

Admin 中间件负责登录、操作、数据访问和权限等业务事实并自行异步入库；API 与策略评估事实由 Core 采集、投递并异步入库。队列不可用时记录投递错误，不回退到已删除的旧表。

六类审计日志一律异步入库：请求中间件只构造事件并投递队列，只有 `base.audit.event` 与 `admin.audit.event` 的消费者可以调用日志 Repository。队列不可用或事件序列化失败时只记录运行日志，不允许在请求线程同步回退写库。

## 6. Core 与 Admin 的职责边界

### 6.1 `kratos-core` 负责

- 定义通用 `AuditEvent`、事件类型、脱敏上下文和 `AuditEmitter/AuditSink` 接口。
- 在 HTTP/gRPC 传输层采集 API 请求事实。
- 在授权中间件内采集鉴权允许/拒绝和策略评估耗时；拒绝结果必须在中间件提前返回前完成采集，登录结果由 Admin 业务中间件记录。
- 通过 `audit.Pipeline` 投递并消费 `base.audit.event`，使用精简内部模型写入 `base_api_log` 和 `base_policy_evaluation_log`。
- 移除 `logging.Server` 对 `models.BaseLog` 的硬编码，并移除队列服务对 `BaseLogRepository` 的强制依赖。

Core 不依赖 `base_login_log`、`base_permission_log` 等 Admin 业务模型，也不提供日志菜单和管理端页面。

### 6.2 `kratos-admin` 负责

- 定义六张 `base_*_log` 表的完整 GORM 模型，统一负责模型注册、自动迁移和查询 Repository。
- 投递并消费 `admin.audit.event`，异步写入登录、操作、数据访问和权限日志。
- 提供六组只读 Proto、查询服务、管理端页面、菜单和管理员权限。
- 保留 `base_job_log` 作为 Core 任务执行日志；它不属于六类安全审计。

### 6.3 目标数据流

```text
Core HTTP/gRPC 采集
  -> Core audit.Pipeline
Core 认证/授权采集
  -> Core audit.Pipeline
Core audit.Pipeline
  -> base.audit.event
  -> Core API/策略日志 Repository
Admin 业务 Case 采集操作/数据/权限事实
  -> Admin AuditSink
  -> admin.audit.event
  -> Admin 登录/操作/数据访问/权限日志 Repository
```

### 6.4 跨仓库实施顺序

1. 在 `kratos-core` 增加 `audit.Pipeline`，负责 API/策略事件的队列投递与异步入库，并移除旧 `base_log` 队列契约和仓储。
2. Admin 注册六张完整模型并负责自动迁移；Admin 自身注册 `admin.audit.event` 消费者，异步写入其余四类日志。
3. Admin 删除 `BaseLogService`、`BaseLogCase`、本地 `base_log` 模型/Repository、旧页面和菜单；`OpsMonitoring` 改读 `base_api_log`。
4. 在 Admin 的 `v0.0.1` 保留六类菜单和权限初始化，不增加增量或建表 SQL。
5. 完成 Core 与 Admin 的生成、测试和 Redis/MySQL 联调。

## 7. Proto、服务和管理端

每张表对应一个只读管理服务，所有服务名使用 `Base` 前缀：

| 表 | Proto 服务 | 管理端 HTTP 前缀 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `base_login_log` | `BaseLoginLogService` | `/api/v1/admin/base/login-log` |
| `base_api_log` | `BaseApiLogService` | `/api/v1/admin/base/api-log` |
| `base_operation_log` | `BaseOperationLogService` | `/api/v1/admin/base/operation-log` |
| `base_data_access_log` | `BaseDataAccessLogService` | `/api/v1/admin/base/data-access-log` |
| `base_permission_log` | `BasePermissionLogService` | `/api/v1/admin/base/permission-log` |
| `base_policy_evaluation_log` | `BasePolicyEvaluationLogService` | `/api/v1/admin/base/policy-evaluation-log` |

每个服务第一版只提供：

- `PageBaseXxxLog`：按时间、租户、用户、结果和资源筛选；
- `GetBaseXxxLog`：查看脱敏后的详情。

不暴露 `Create` HTTP API。内部写入使用独立 writer/repository，避免审计接口被普通客户端调用。

管理端页面建议拆成六个菜单页面，列表页复用表格和详情抽屉组件，但每页使用自己的 Proto、字段和查询接口。策略评估页额外展示鉴权引擎、评估类型、资源、动作、决策和耗时。

## 8. 菜单 ID 规划

日志菜单统一挂在现有 `20004` 下，但父菜单名称改为“日志审计”。新安装不考虑旧菜单 ID，不提供兼容映射。

| ID | 父 ID | 类型 | 路径 | 组件 | 标题 | 排序 |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| `20004` | `200` | 目录 | - | - | 日志审计 | 130 |
| `2000401` | `20004` | 菜单 | `base/job` | `system/base/job/index` | 定时任务 | 140 |
| `2000402` | `20004` | 隐藏菜单 | `base/job/log` | `system/base/job/log` | 定时任务日志 | 150 |
| `2000403` | `20004` | 菜单 | `base/login-log` | `system/base/login-log/index` | 登录日志 | 160 |
| `2000404` | `20004` | 菜单 | `base/api-log` | `system/base/api-log/index` | API 访问日志 | 170 |
| `2000405` | `20004` | 菜单 | `base/operation-log` | `system/base/operation-log/index` | 操作日志 | 180 |
| `2000406` | `20004` | 菜单 | `base/data-access-log` | `system/base/data-access-log/index` | 数据访问日志 | 190 |
| `2000407` | `20004` | 菜单 | `base/permission-log` | `system/base/permission-log/index` | 权限日志 | 200 |
| `2000408` | `20004` | 菜单 | `base/policy-evaluation-log` | `system/base/policy-evaluation-log/index` | 策略评估日志 | 210 |
| `2000409` | `20004` | 菜单 | `base/migration` | `system/base/migration/index` | 升级历史 | 220 |

详情按钮统一使用菜单 ID 的 `01` 后缀：

```text
200040201  查询定时任务日志详情
200040301  查询登录日志详情
200040401  查询 API 访问日志详情
200040501  查询操作日志详情
200040601  查询数据访问日志详情
200040701  查询权限日志详情
200040801  查询策略评估日志详情
```

按钮路径分别为 `base:<resource>:info`，只绑定对应服务的 `GetBaseXxxLog`；菜单本身绑定对应服务的 `PageBaseXxxLog` 和必要的详情接口。

角色范围：

- 超级管理员：通过超级管理员内置策略拥有全部日志权限。
- 平台管理员：拥有 `20004` 及其子菜单和详情按钮。
- 租户管理员、普通用户、认证用户：不加入 `20004`、`2000401` 至 `2000409` 及其按钮 ID。

## 9. `v0.0.1` 修改范围

只修改现有 `backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/mysql` 初始化资源：

1. `default_data.up.sql`：替换 `20004` 下旧系统日志菜单，写入新的菜单 ID、组件、API 权限和管理员角色菜单集合。
2. `i18n.*.up.sql`：按新菜单 ID 更新日志菜单标题和详情按钮标题；不为日志表字段新增动态国际化数据。
3. 不新增 `v0.0.2`、`v0.0.3` 或其他增量目录。
4. 不写 `CREATE TABLE`、`ALTER TABLE`、`DROP TABLE`、`DELETE` 等建表或清理语句。
5. 六张表由 GORM 自动迁移模型创建；迁移资源只负责菜单、API 与角色初始化。
6. 不考虑旧 `base_log` 数据，也不提供旧接口兼容。

## 10. 实施顺序

```text
冻结本文档
  -> 在开发库建立六张空表并执行 gorm-gen
  -> 定义六组 Proto 并生成 Go/OpenAPI/TS
  -> 实现六个只读 Service/Case/Repository
  -> Core 投递并消费 API/策略事件，使用宿主已初始化的日志表入库
  -> 接入登录、API、操作、数据、权限、策略评估写入器
  -> 实现六个管理端页面
  -> 修改 v0.0.1 菜单、按钮、角色集合和 i18n
  -> 运行生成、测试、lint、i18n 校验
```

Core 不再创建或写入 `base_log`；六类审计事实均由 Admin 拆分表承载。
